guide.name: Get visible guide
guide.autoOn: Open the guide automatically on each step

planEasy.title: The {easy} plan, free
planEasy.text: Answer a few questions and the assistant builds you a one-page site. Tap the button to start.

planAdvanced.title: The {advanced} plan
planAdvanced.text: AI builder with real code, unlimited pages and booking forms. It has a one-time fee, shown on the card.

planLater.title: The account comes later
planLater.text: You need no account to start. You create it once your site and area are set.

studioChat.title: Talk to the assistant
studioChat.text: Answer the questions here. Your site is built from your answers.

studioProgress.title: Where you are
studioProgress.text: See the current question and how much is left.

studioTabs.title: {chat} or {preview}
studioTabs.text: Tap "{preview}" to see your site, then go back to "{chat}" to continue.

studioPreview.title: Live preview
studioPreview.text: Your site shows up here and updates as you answer.

studioPhotos.title: Photos of your work
studioPhotos.text: Add photos with the plus button. This step is optional, you can skip it.

studioCustomize.title: Customize
studioCustomize.text: Pick another template or color for your site.

studioContinue.title: Your site is ready
studioContinue.text: When you like how it looks, tap here to choose what you offer and where you work.

pitchName.title: Business name
pitchName.text: Type your business name. The rest of the details come in the next steps.

pitchCta.title: Continue
pitchCta.text: The button turns on once you type the name.

locCategory.title: What you offer
locCategory.text: Pick the field, then one or more services. This is how customers looking for exactly that find you.

locArea.title: Where you work
locArea.text: Pick one or more counties, or "{nationwide}". You appear in the feed for searches in the chosen area.

locMap.title: Exact address, optional
locMap.text: Tap the map to mark your address. It only shows on your page and does not change where you appear.

locContinue.title: Continue
locContinue.text: Turns on once you pick at least one service and one area.

accNew.title: Create your account
accNew.text: Name, email and a password of at least 8 characters. Then you confirm your email with a code.

accSigned.title: You're already signed in
accSigned.text: The business is added to your account. If there is a fee, you see it above the button.

accVerify.title: Check your email
accVerify.text: Enter the 6-digit code you received. Didn't get it? Check Spam or request it again.

unlPrice.title: One-time fee
unlPrice.text: You pay once from your wallet and unlock the advanced builder.

unlShort.title: Not enough credits
unlShort.text: You're a few credits short of unlocking. No problem, I'll help you add them.

unlPay.title: Unlock
unlPay.text: After paying you go straight to the builder.

v2Chat.title: Say what site you want
v2Chat.text: Describe your business and what you want on the site. The assistant builds it and you refine it by message. Uses wallet credits.

v2Tabs.title: Switch the view
v2Tabs.text: Move between the chat, the files and the site preview.

v2Preview.title: Preview
v2Preview.text: See your site running here as the assistant builds it.

v2Publish.title: {publish}
v2Publish.text: When you're happy, publish the site. You can't move on without publishing.

v2Continue.title: Continue to budget
v2Continue.text: The button turns on after the first publish.

budgetAuto.title: Automatic or manual
budgetAuto.text: On, the platform handles bidding for you. Off, you choose the placement and cost per click.

budgetTiers.title: Placement
budgetTiers.text: Choose "{standard}" or "{first}". The values below fill in on their own and you can change them.

budgetFields.title: Budget and cost per click
budgetFields.text: The daily budget is the most spent per day. The cost per click is the most paid for one click.

budgetShort.title: You need more credits
budgetShort.text: Your balance doesn't cover the chosen budget. Add credits from the wallet.

budgetSave.title: Save
budgetSave.text: Save your settings, then move on to the activation step.

launchActivate.title: {activate}
launchActivate.text: Tap the button so your business appears in the feed. You can stop it anytime.

launchLinks.title: Adjust anytime
launchLinks.text: Change your budget or see optimization tips from here.

launchFinish.title: Finish
launchFinish.text: Turns on once the campaign is active and takes you to your dashboard.

unlAddCredits.title: Add credits
unlAddCredits.text: Press “{addCredits}”. I'll take you to your wallet, guide you through payment and then bring you back here to unlock the builder.

walletUnlock.title: You're almost there
walletUnlock.text: Here you can see how many credits you still need to unlock the advanced builder. It updates right after payment.

walletTopup.title: Top up your wallet
walletTopup.text: Press “{topUp}”, pick an amount (at least what you are missing) and pay by card.

walletBack.title: The way back
walletBack.text: After paying, press “{backToUnlock}” to return to the unlock step.

walletReady.title: You have enough credits
walletReady.text: Done! Press “{backToUnlock}” to unlock the builder and carry on.

startScratch.title: Create from scratch
startScratch.text: The assistant builds your site and campaign, step by step.

startOptimize.title: Already on Google Ads?
startOptimize.text: Connect your account and the agent optimizes your existing campaign. Setup is free.

adsConnect.title: Connect with Google
adsConnect.text: Sign in with Google and allow access to Google Ads. You come right back here.

adsFree.title: Free until the first cycle
adsFree.text: You only pay when you start an optimization.

adsAccounts.title: Pick the account
adsAccounts.text: If you have several Google Ads accounts, pick the one with your campaign.

adsCampaignList.title: Pick the campaign
adsCampaignList.text: Real results from the last 30 days help you recognize it.

adsCampaignContinue.title: Continue
adsCampaignContinue.text: One more step: your account on the platform.

adsAccountSigned.title: You are signed in
adsAccountSigned.text: Press Continue and the campaign shows up in your dashboard.

adsAccountNew.title: New account
adsAccountNew.text: Fill in your details; you get a code by email to confirm.

adsAccountLogin.title: Already have an account?
adsAccountLogin.text: Sign in and you come right back to this step.

adsAccountVerify.title: Confirm your email
adsAccountVerify.text: Type the 6-digit code from your email.

adsTabs.title: Campaign dashboard
adsTabs.text: Overview, agent, proposals, settings and costs, all for your Google Ads campaign.

adsQuote.title: See the estimate
adsQuote.text: The analysis is free: see what the agent will do and what it costs before you pay.

adsPrice.title: The price
adsPrice.text: It depends on the complexity of the work. In the end you only pay for what was done.

adsStart.title: Start optimizing
adsStart.text: The agent works by itself; follow its activity live.

adsProposals.title: Proposals
adsProposals.text: Budget changes and rewrites wait here for your approval.

adsSettings.title: Agent settings
adsSettings.text: Choose what the agent may do on its own and whether it runs automatically.
